title: Work
description: An abstract intellectual creation, independent of any particular text, translation, or physical form (FRBR 'work'): the Gospel of John, the Quran, a specific letter, a speech. Editions realize works.

sortTitle.description: Title normalized for sorting (articles stripped, transliterated).

genre.description: Free-form genre hint (e.g. 'scripture', 'monograph', 'letter', 'academic-paper', 'speech', 'transcript'). Informative only; never drives parsing or rendering.

refScheme.description: Default canonical reference scheme for this work (e.g. 'bible', 'quran', 'monograph'). Registered in the reference-scheme registry; editions may override.

date.description: Composition date or range, free-form ('1863', 'c. 90 AD').
